description: Run a telegram CLI command that sends, edits, deletes or changes something (or saves files: download, sync), e.g. ["send","@user","-"] with stdin as the text. Needs write access (mode "ask" after setup; if writes are off, call telegram_setup so the user can choose). In mode "ask" the user approves each write: either the client shows them a dialog, or the result has status "approval_required" with the action and a code (not an error); then show the user that action word for word, and only after their explicit yes call again with the same args, stdin and "approval": "<code>". Writes need an ID, @username or exact chat title.

approval.description: Only in write mode "ask" when the user is not asked by a dialog: the code from the previous result, passed after the user said yes to that exact action in the chat. Never approve on the user's behalf.

args.description: CLI argv, command first, one item per word: ["send","-1004001","-"] (text in stdin)

stdin.description: Text for a "-" argument (message body), avoids quoting issues

name: telegram_write

exitCode.description: The CLI's exit code (0 ok, 1 runtime, 2 usage, 4 writes off, 5 not logged in)

output.description: The result as the model reads it: the command's output (its JSON as text with --json), an error or what to do next. The same text as content.

status.description: approval_required, human_required, nothing_to_do, done, open_page or ready

stderr.description: What the CLI printed on stderr

title: Write to Telegram
